violations.text: Food packaged in the food establishment are lacking adequate label information. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of all ingredients, the quantity of the contents, major allergens and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The screen door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. The screen is in poor repair and the bottom of the door has a gap. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

The floor behind the water heater has a small accumulation of old rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

Various foods were observed held between 93-114 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food was cooked at 9:00. Food was moved to walk-in. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/03/2024
